propositions: Teams running multiple tracker projects against one codebase cannot currently use the bridge because it is hardwired to a single project at three independent points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL derivation, and applier cross-project guard

A shared ticket store between N repos and N tracker projects must own the project mapping (at .bridge_state/projects.json) to prevent each repo from seeing other projects' tickets as remote deletions when diffing against a shared prev_snapshot.json

Each ticket must record both the project it syncs into and the repos it belongs to, with tri-state project field (absent=legacy default, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) and no events written during migration

A store with more than one project must carry the multi-project-bridge capability in required_capabilities and reject writes from binaries lacking it, while single-project stores remain writable by older binaries

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate the configured project set for base JQL and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps), merging results into a shared snapshot keyed by issue with per-project truncation ceilings
Outbound dispatch must use per-ticket project on create and relax the cross-project guard from single configured project to set membership, with explicit-empty project producing no mutations
